$comment: Provenance registry for developing-country.org. One entry per source; the MCP catalog projects source location, field schema, freshness, completeness, and storage for every queryable dataset. `refresh` is a Bun command, `curated`, or a live source. `refreshed` is when evidence was last fetched or re-verified.

freshness_policy.meaning: A stale flag requests review; it never silently replaces a Dataset Version or changes a published Data View.
